extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1990s police patrol car (full-size sedan), approx. 5.1 x 2.0 x 1.8 m (L x W x H incl. light bar and antenna), wheel diameter 0.68 m
extras.notes: generic 1990s police cruiser identified only by its white and sky-blue paint scheme and the roof light bar (emissive blue and red domes), plus push bar, spotlight and antenna; no lettering, no badges, no brand; front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench and steering wheel; blank number plates

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
